summary: drivers/newchirp_static_bank_compat.py: integer zone spans, labels Zone 1-10 and model name Zones; zones stay read-only (a channel's zone is its channel number). Affects BF-F8HP-PRO, GM-21, GM-32, UV-17ProGPS, UV-21ProGPS, UV-28Plus, UV-29Pro, UV-32, GM-30 Plus/Pro, RT-910, RT-910 BT, Bajeton BJ7800.
